chunks: Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, said:
"A well from which water is used for ghusl (ritual washing) and wudu (ablution) is not disliked, whether it is near or far, so long as the water has not changed."

key_terms.بِئْرٌ: a well as a source of water
key_terms.لَيْسَ يُكْرَهُ: it is not considered disliked in legal usage
key_terms.مَا لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرِ الْمَاءُ: so long as the water has not undergone a change affecting its state
key_terms.يُغْتَسَلُ: ritual washing is performed with it

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to use well water for ghusl (ritual washing) and wudu (ablution) if the well is near or far?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the use of well water for ghusl (ritual washing) and wudu (ablution). It indicates that the well’s nearness or distance does not make its use disliked, as long as the water itself remains unchanged.
